scene_name: Cozy Attic Loft Studio with String Lights and Plants
short_caption: A warm, wood-paneled creative loft filled with hanging Edison bulbs, string fairy lights, and lush potted indoor plants.
literal_description: A warm attic loft featuring exposed wooden ceiling beams and dark hardwood flooring. Multiple strands of warm fairy lights and hanging exposed-filament Edison bulbs illuminate the room with an amber glow. A large white-framed grid window stands at the far wall overlooking an evening exterior with blurred light reflections. Dense clusters of vibrant potted houseplants, including large peace lilies or cast iron plants, fiddle leaf figs, climbing golden pothos vines wrapped around a wooden support pillar, and potted monsteras, line the perimeter. An industrial vertical metal riser pipe stands on the left. In the foreground right, an armchair with a golden-yellow and beige cushion sits next to a small round dark wooden accent table holding a shallow ceramic or metallic bowl.
environment: Indoor creative loft studio with wooden post-and-beam architecture, hardwood flooring, brick accent wall, and a large rear window.
visual_style: photorealistic, warm, atmospheric interior, cinematic lighting
lighting: Warm ambient glow from numerous hanging Edison incandescent bulbs and crisscrossing string lights, low cool fill from the rear evening window, soft deep shadows under furniture.
atmosphere: Cozy, tranquil, warm indoor air with gentle amber illumination and no visible haze or smoke.
ambient_sound: Faint warm hum of electrical filaments, soft distant nocturnal city ambiance outside the window, subtle rustle of indoor foliage, quiet acoustic room presence.
